name: Main Hall (Northshire)
summary: Newcomers report in the Main Hall at Northshire Abbey in western Elwynn. From there, they reach the Hall of Arms, the Library Wing, and the abbey tower, then receive their first assignments defending Stormwind.

sections.title: Heart of the Abbey
sections.body: Trainees and clerics pass through the Main Hall after entering Northshire Abbey. The chamber links the Hall of Arms, where recruits prepare for battle, with the Library Wing and the stairs to the abbey tower. Strife in the valley reaches even this quiet place, and officers rally able newcomers to defend the kingdom's borders.

faq.q: What is the purpose of the Main Hall?
faq.answer: The Main Hall links the Hall of Arms, the Library Wing, and Northshire Abbey's upper tower. Recruits, priests, and visitors pass through this central chamber.
Stormwind defense officers and clerics stationed in the Main Hall assess incoming adventurers and give them their first orders: clear threats from the abbey grounds.

angles.text: As a human of the kingdom, you begin your service to Stormwind and the Holy Light in the Main Hall of Northshire Abbey.
